description: This file defines the 'BuzzShareDecorator' class, which provides methods to manipulate 'BuzzShare' entities, such as adjusting comment and like counts, and associating employees via employee numbers. It's a part of the OrangeHRM project, specifically within the decorator pattern implementation for BuzzShare entities.

classes.name: BuzzShareDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for BuzzShare entity, providing methods to modify comment and like counts and associate employees.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a BuzzShare entity.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity to the BuzzShare based on employee number.

methods.name: increaseNumOfCommentsByOne
methods.description: Increments the number of comments on the BuzzShare by one.

methods.name: decreaseNumOfCommentsByOne
methods.description: Decrements the number of comments on the BuzzShare by one.

methods.name: increaseNumOfLikesByOne
methods.description: Increments the number of likes on the BuzzShare by one.

methods.name: decreaseNumOfLikesByOne
methods.description: Decrements the number of likes on the BuzzShare by one.
